about: Stop 2 (Kitchen counter) first frame, first person, three seeds. Starts on the protein cabinet and counter with the sink (second mug) entering on the right; the 6-second move continues to the pantry.

input.prompt: First-person point of view, vertical photograph: the exact view of someone standing at their kitchen counter mid-morning, looking straight ahead at chest height. In the centre of the frame, a run of honed dark stone countertop that has clearly been cooked on, with a plain upper cabinet above it: solid dark-oak doors, closed, no glass, simple brass pulls. On the counter below the cabinet, a stainless blender base with its jar, and one plain matte shaker bottle with no label. On the right third of the frame the counter continues to a deep undermount sink with a brushed brass tap; in the sink sits a single used ceramic mug, left there earlier. Mid-morning sun, higher and harder than dawn, comes from a window out of frame on the left and throws crisp, clean shadows of the tap and blender across the stone. Walls of dark warm-grey matte paint; the rest of the kitchen falls into deep, soft shadow at the edges. Quiet, expensive in materials not objects: real wood, stone that is actually stone, matte surfaces, deliberately underfurnished, lived in, not styled. Low-contrast shadows with real light cutting through, fine natural film grain, documentary, shot on a 35mm lens. The cabinet, blender and sink are well inside the frame; nothing important near the left or right edges. No person, no hands, no reflections of a person, no window in frame, no plants, no herbs, no fruit bowl, no flowers, no candles, no coffee steam, no marble, no text, no labels, no logos.
